scenes.title: Nancy Kanwisher comparing Faces vs Houses/Hands on the 1997 MGH fMRI console beside an inverted 'Thatcher' portrait flip
scenes.era: 1997, Massachusetts General Hospital NMR Center / MIT cognitive neuroscience lab, Boston

layout.description: Sunlit 1997 neuroimaging control room overlooking a clean white MRI bore window; on the oak console desk sit five printed visual control stimulus cards (Intact Faces, Houses, Scrambled Faces, Spoons, Human Hands), a rotatable upright/inverted portrait frame, and a crisp monitor highlighting the right ventral fusiform spot.

positions.who: Nancy Kanwisher (mannequin in 1997 collared shirt and blazer)
positions.where: standing at the imaging console rotating an upside-down portrait card 180 degrees upright while pointing to the tall 'Faces' response bar towering 2x above Houses, Scrambled, and Hands
positions.facing: facing the stimulus cards and monitor

positions.who: Josh McDermott / Marvin Chun (mannequin in rolled Oxford sleeves)
positions.where: checking off all five rigorous visual control runs across 12 individual brain maps

props.name: five-card 1997 control deck (Faces / Houses / Scrambled / Objects / Hands)
props.period_detail: five high-contrast grayscale test cards spread neatly across the oak console
props.physical_behavior: prove low-level contrast and animate body parts fail to trigger the 2x face surge

props.name: 180-degree swivel portrait frame ('Upright vs Inverted Face')
props.period_detail: wooden tabletop swivel frame demonstrating holistic lock upright vs piecemeal drop inverted

props.name: Faces (2x) vs Objects/Hands bar graph & ventral fusiform map
props.period_detail: crisp white monitor chart showing the sharp step-function jump solely for intact faces

actions.verb_sequence: slides the Houses, Scrambled, and Hands cards under the camera showing low baseline bars -> slides the Upright Face card forward as the right-fusiform bar leaps twice as high -> flips the swivel portrait upside down watching holistic tuning drop
overlays 12 individual ventral fusiform maps confirming reproducible anatomy

reactions.reaction: nods having survived five attempts to falsify her own face-module hypothesis
notes adjacent Place (PPA) and Body (EBA) patches right next door

scenes.wardrobe: 1997 Boston academic wear: tailored blazer over crisp collared shirt and chinos; rolled-sleeve Oxford button-down.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key New England control-room daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Test houses, spoons, scrambled pixels, or human hands and this pea-sized patch stays quiet — flash an upright human face and it jumps twice as high in milliseconds.

key_visual.description: a 1997 neuroscientist at an fMRI console desk comparing five grayscale test cards (Faces vs Houses/Hands) and a swivel portrait frame beside a 2x response bar chart

scenes.title: The Thatcher Illusion: Normal upside down, shocking right-side up

layout.description: Bright seminar table where two upside-down portrait cards look nearly identical until rotated 180 degrees upright.

positions.where: leaning back in instant surprise the millisecond the inverted portrait rotates upright

props.name: twin rotatable portrait plaques
props.period_detail: demonstrate holistic eye-mouth configuration switching ON only when upright
props.physical_behavior: visceral classroom proof of FFA tuning

actions.verb_sequence: rotates both upside-down plaques 180° upright -> holistic mismatch jumps out instantly

reactions.reaction: gasp and laugh seeing how blind they were upside down

scenes.recognition_hook: Upside down your FFA takes a coffee break — flip the portrait upright and distorted spacing jumps out in a tenth of a second.

scenes.title: 2012 Stanford Awake Stimulation: Only the doctor's face morphs

layout.description: Bright hospital room where an awake patient looks calmly at a doctor standing beside a wall TV and clipboard.

positions.where: standing at the foot of the bed holding a clipboard
pointing in amazement strictly at the doctor's face while gesturing that the clipboard and room look 100% normal

props.name: milliampere cortical stimulator switch
props.period_detail: delivers a brief harmless pulse strictly to right FFA electrodes

actions.verb_sequence: applies brief 1-second right-FFA stimulation -> Patient reports the doctor's features shifted instantly while the room stayed rock-solid

reactions.reaction: logs causal proof of human FFA specificity

scenes.wardrobe: Crisp white physician coat and clean patient sweater.
scenes.recognition_hook: Stimulate right FFA directly in an awake human, and ONLY the real person's face in front of them warps while the room stays rock-solid.

scenes.title: Eye-level upright framing in everyday human connection

layout.description: Sunlit desk where raising a laptop onto a wooden stand brings the camera to clean upright eye level.

positions.where: adjusting laptop stand to natural eye level for clear face-to-face rapport

actions.verb_sequence: lifts camera to eye level and turns toward window light

scenes.recognition_hook: Clear, well-lit eye-level framing feeds the exact holistic upright geometry your listener's FFA evolved to read.
